about: How every weapon and armour piece of the items ladder is forged and tempered (docs/design/items.md, section Smithing), as Skyrim does it (decision 0034): `python3 -m tools.newworld.stockdb recipes` measures the shape of Skyrim's own forge recipes per weapon type and armour slot (how many of the main material, how many leather strips) and the perk each Skyrim material keyword asks for, then writes newworld/sources/stock/recipes.json (generated) for every item of item_material: a forge recipe (CraftingSmithingForge) and a tempering recipe (CraftingSmithingSharpeningWheel for a weapon, CraftingSmithingArmorTable for armour), the ingredients our material's (below), the perk its power class's. A mod's own recipe is kept where every ingredient is one of ours (keep_when_ours); otherwise it is overridden. Ruin, unique and relic materials, and every T6 piece, temper but are never forged. Every ingredient is a ware with an item_good row, so who makes or sells it is known.
